parsed.title: Planned Maintenance Battery Swap on S-SFX-001
parsed.root_cause_summary: Battery swap performed on site S-SFX-001 during scheduled maintenance window MW-0001, resulting in expected site down impact.
parsed.confidence_reason: Exact timing match between maintenance window and traffic drop, with expected impact explicitly stated as site down.
parsed.impact_summary: Site S-SFX-001 experienced a 2-hour drop in availability and traffic during the scheduled maintenance window.

timeline.event: Maintenance window MW-0001 started for battery swap on S-SFX-001.
Alert ALR-0003 started: traffic, active users, and availability dropped on S-SFX-001.
Maintenance window MW-0001 completed and alert ALR-0003 ended.

findings.claim: Site S-SFX-001 availability, traffic, and active users dropped to zero from 2026-09-03 03:00 to 05:00.
Maintenance window MW-0001 for battery swap on S-SFX-001 was scheduled from 2026-09-03 03:00 to 05:00 with expected impact site down.
No alarms occurred on S-SFX-001, LNK-SFX-01-A, or AGG-SFX-01 between 2026-09-03 00:00 and 09:00.
No changes occurred on S-SFX-001, LNK-SFX-01-A, AGG-SFX-01, or its parents between 2026-09-03 00:00 and 09:00.

hypotheses.reason: The outage perfectly aligns in timing and expected impact with the scheduled battery swap maintenance window MW-0001.
No alarms or changes were found on the transport link or aggregation router during the incident window.

dismissed_signals.reason: No alarms were present on the site or parent nodes to indicate an unplanned failure.
No unplanned configuration or software changes were executed during the window.

recommended_actions: No escalation is required as this was a planned maintenance activity.
Verify service recovery metrics on S-SFX-001 following the completed maintenance.
